method: Best checkpoint by validation token CE; overfit flag requires validation increase >0.05 after best while train CE continues decreasing; NLL/byte retained for cross-vocabulary comparison.
overfit_flag_definition: final validation token CE - final train token CE > 0.5 (descriptive alarm; nats/byte should be used across differing vocabularies)

assessment.training_sufficiency: All10 completed at least25 epochs; all stopped by patience, none reached80. Optimization stabilized under this schedule; this is not proof of downstream adequacy.
assessment.overfitting: Small validation deterioration after best and decreasing training loss indicate mild late overfitting in several runs. Source-group distribution shift and unequal augmentation also contribute.
assessment.cross_split_warning: Different held-out sets; do not rank split811 vs622 by validation loss.
